title: Rational design and comparative docking and simulation of modified FLT3 inhibitors: A study on enhanced binding stability and inhibition potency
authors: Uddalak Das; Dheemanth Regati; R. Sowdhamini; Jitendra Kumar
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过分子对接和MD模拟设计FLT3激酶抑制剂，对象为蛋白-小分子互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: The FLT3 protein is a well-established therapeutic target in the treatment of Acute Myeloid Leukemia (AML), with its inhibition playing a crucial role in disease management. In this study, we identify and propose a novel FLT3 inhibitor that demonstrates superior binding affinity, stability, and pharmacokinetic properties compared to currently available inhibitors. We initially characterized the binding interactions of known FLT3 inhibitors through molecular docking and then strategically modified functional groups to enhance binding affinity, optimize drug-likeness, and minimize toxicity. The resulting analogue exhibits improved metabolic stability, lower toxicity, higher intestinal absorption, and superior permeability. Molecular dynamics simulations further confirm that the novel inhibitor forms stable and persistent interactions with FLT3, as evidenced by reduced conformational fluctuations and compact structural integrity. Free energy calculations reveal stronger ligand stabilization, while dynamic correlation analysis suggests enhanced engagement with critical residues, reinforcing its potential as an effective therapeutic agent. These findings highlight a promising candidate for further experimental validation and potential development in AML treatment.
abstract_zh: FLT3蛋白是急性髓系白血病（AML）治疗中公认的治疗靶点，其抑制在疾病管理中发挥关键作用。在本研究中，我们识别并提出一种新型FLT3抑制剂，该抑制剂相较于现有抑制剂表现出更优的结合亲和力、稳定性和药代动力学特性。我们首先通过分子对接 (molecular docking) 表征已知FLT3抑制剂的结合相互作用，随后策略性地修饰官能团以增强结合亲和力、优化类药性并最小化毒性。所得类似物表现出改善的代谢稳定性、更低的毒性、更高的肠道吸收和优越的渗透性。分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟进一步证实，该新型抑制剂与FLT3形成稳定且持久的相互作用，表现为构象波动减少和结构完整性紧凑。自由能计算揭示更强的配体稳定化作用，而动态相关性分析提示与关键残基的增强结合，强化其作为有效治疗剂的潜力。这些发现突显了一个有前景的候选分子，值得进一步实验验证及在AML治疗中的潜在开发。
